questions.question: The manager insisted that the report ______ before noon.
questions.explanation: insist that + 주어 + (should) 동사원형 → 수동이므로 be p.p. (본동사 자리)

questions.question: She seems ______ the answer, judging from her confident tone.
______ that he was wrong, he apologized immediately.
What he said ______ true at first, but later proved false.
I would rather ______ at home than go out in this weather.
questions.explanation: would rather + 동사원형 → 준동사처럼 보이지만 원형동사 구조

questions.question: The problem is difficult ______ without proper guidance.
He denied ______ any involvement in the incident.
Not ______ enough evidence, the police released the suspect.
The teacher made the students ______ the assignment again.
questions.explanation: 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 동사원형 → 본동사 아님 (목적보어)

questions.question: Each of the students ______ responsible for the result.
questions.explanation: 주어 each → 단수 취급, 본동사 자리
